facts.text: Property at Remuera, Auckland: the previous owner carried out the building work as builder; the current owner and a neighbouring owner (the applicant) are parties; Auckland Council is the authority.
Matter: partly completed Type 3 timber retaining wall and associated sitework under building consent BCO10257508.
Background (§3, pp.10–18) and submissions (§4, pp.19–24) describe the wall's construction and the neighbour's concerns; discussion §7 at pp.25–34.
Decision: the partly completed Type 3 retaining wall and associated sitework comply with B1 Structure and E1 Surface Water as they relate to protection of other property (23 June 2022).
